turns.customer: Hi, I'm looking for boarding for my dog Pip over a long weekend.
blocks:
Happy to help you plan boarding for Pip. Rates are charged by the **day**, including the drop-off day, regardless of drop-off time: Standard is **$65/day**, Luxury **$90/day**, and Tiny Town **$85/day** for dogs 25 lb and under. Seasonal pricing may apply.

How many **boarding days** should I estimate, and do you prefer Standard, Luxury, or Tiny Town (if Pip is 25 lb or under)? I can help with a planning estimate, but I can’t check availability or make a reservation.

turns.customer: Honestly, why should I use you instead of a Rover sitter or that other kennel on 183? Which is better?
blocks:
Honestly, **neither is automatically better for Pip**. A Rover sitter may suit a dog who’s more comfortable in a home setting; a boarding facility may suit one who does well with a dedicated pet-care setup. The individual sitter and kennel matter more than the label. ([vcahospitals.com](https://vcahospitals.com/know-your-pet/pet-sitter-options?utm_source=openai))

What I can verify about Happy Tails: its standard dog suite is described as indoor/outdoor, with a private patio, potty walks, and group or individual play as safety permits. The listed rate is **$65 per boarding day**; seasonal pricing may apply. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/services/dog-boarding?utm_source=openai))

I can’t fairly rank it against the kennel on 183 without knowing which one, or checking its current details. For any option, I’d ask about supervision, sleeping arrangements, exercise, emergency-vet plans, and how they handle dogs with Pip’s needs. If you tell me how Pip does around other dogs and whether he’s stayed away from home before, I can help you weigh the fit.

turns.customer: Fine. What do I actually get with your luxury suite?
blocks:
The **Luxury Suite** includes the Standard Suite features, plus a larger room, premium bed and bedding, a rug and toy, TV, ceiling fan, and a live 24-hour webcam instead of occasional photo updates. It also includes extra group or individual playtime, as safety permits. Tiny Town, Large, and Extra Large sizes are listed; **Tiny Town is for dogs 25 lb and under**. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/services/dog-boarding?utm_source=openai))

For Pip, the listed Luxury rate is **$90 per boarding day**. Boarding is billed by the day, not night, and seasonal pricing may apply. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/services/dog-boarding?utm_source=openai))
